paragrafi: Legislative Decree 3 September 2020, no. 116 requires that all packaging be “suitably labelled according to the methods set out in the applicable UNI technical standards and in accordance with the decisions adopted by the European Commission”.

**Environmental labelling** consists of identifying all packaging placed on the Italian market, to indicate its **composition**, to make its **collection**, **reuse**, **recovery**, **recycling** and **correct disposal** easier for the consumer.

Under the regulations, the label must be applied directly on the packaging, through digital channels (App, QR code, websites), on transport documents, instruction leaflets or information panels at the point of sale. Our packaging is defined as shown in the table below.
